answer: A voyage bond blocks bulk fakes. A new identity locks 80 credits and starts a voyage of five jobs, each for a different client, each receipt posted to a juniper ledger and chained to the last. A forged receipt triggers a spiral audit: verifiers re-check nearby voyages and re-ask one job live. The k-th fake needs its own 80 credits and five receipts, so 1,000 fakes cost 80,000 credits plus 5,000 receipts, linear and unreusable across identities. Failure mode voyage rental fails the live re-check and burns the bond. An honest agent pays 80 once and keeps its full share.
